hypothesis: The dominant unexplained cost is lazy runtime initialization. Module cardinality and its square may separate cold and warmed execution, while token count and sampling mode explain steady-state differences.

pcvs.name: prompt_token_count
pcvs.rationale: Captures the linear minimum and maximum token-ID validation scans.

pcvs.name: sampling_enabled
pcvs.rationale: Captures differences between greedy and sampling parameter processing.

pcvs.name: loaded_module_count
pcvs.rationale: Runtime import state can distinguish expensive lazy initialization from subsequent requests; the first report contains one exceptionally expensive call.

pcvs.name: loaded_module_count_squared
pcvs.rationale: Allows nonlinear dependence on runtime initialization state as different sets of dependencies become loaded.
